source: A re-asked question. In the WP-149 A1 read (evidence/wp149-confirmation/a1/A1.1.md) g1.1 asked «Say if you trust Solvel.», the learner answered «Je ne sais pas encore. Mais je ne pars pas demain.», and the ending promised Romy «reviendra demain pour une phrase claire»; g1.2 asked again at the same counter. The two real days are the recent days here; the first plan has Romy ask the g1.1 question again and must cost only a new plan.
